description: This file defines a JavaScript module for creating a discrete values chart using D3.js, including functions for rendering SVG elements, handling tooltips, and animating text transitions.

methods.name: findValue
methods.description: Retrieves nested property value from an object based on dot-separated path.

methods.name: tweenText
methods.description: Creates a transition tween for animating text content from current to new value.

methods.name: generator
methods.description: Main function that generates the discrete values chart within a D3 selection.
